title: ML REST-to-Nostr bridge ingress semantics
intent: Make ML browser import/deploy semantics explicit: HTTP submits to a bridge that publishes signed Nostr ML command events and returns correlation metadata, while completion remains Nostr event/read-model driven.
observed_behavior: web/src/routes/ml/+page.svelte submits import/deploy through api.importMLModel() and api.deployMLEndpoint().
internal/api/handlers/ml.go publishes ML request events through MLCommandPublisher and returns HTTP 202 command receipts.
internal/controlplane/ml_command_publisher.go signs ML request events, requires relay acceptance, and returns request/result/read-model correlation metadata.
intended_behavior: The ML web route and docs classify browser import/deploy as REST-to-Nostr bridge ingress, not signer-first browser publishing.
HTTP 202 means publish acceptance only and never terminal workflow completion.
Terminal completion is observed through correlated ML result kinds and ML read-model projections.
Existing endpoint worker pinning remains signer-first browser Nostr command ingress.
